full_details: The court came up to Whitehall today. On the post by the Bull you read a new Rose bill, A Toy to Please Chaste Ladies, and you did not cross the river. The title set you thinking of women of a citizen's own size, quarrelling. On your tables, under the note of the Duke's wedding from three weeks since, you wrote two maids in the wood, one little and one tall, and the initials N. S. and A. M., and that they should fall out about it. You have no scene for it. You have a pair of boys of the right heights. At the Theatre, with the book licensed and the parts not out, Phillips played two measures of a minor Italian pavan and stopped. You counted sixteen bars for old Capulet's welcome and for Tybalt knowing a Montague under the mask, and then the bass viol down so the fourteen lines can float. Burbage and Nick spoke them at half voice, palm to palm, and stopped when the music stopped. Nick stayed under the note the whole way. You wrote the bar-counts in the margin. At two you were Egeon again.
one_sentence: You read a Rose title twice, and at the Theatre you counted sixteen bars for the feast.
title: A Rose title, and sixteen bars
